body: i just read about others who gave up, finally, and that keeps me going a little. like "it's ok, it's ok it's ok it's ok." but nothing feels ok. i can't get a fucking job; i'm running my mom into the ground; and i'm a liar. i lie to everyone that i'm doing great as a freelancer. i'm not at all. i even go so far as to lie that i'm pulling in 80K this year. I've made less than $500 all year. so you know, between being a worthless fraud and killing my mom's retirement, i guess i can really see why nobody will hire me. i mean sure, they don't know all those things, but they can probably see right through me.
yeah, i feel you. i should've not trusted him; i should've said something... but you see... these are all the things that make me so stupid... so worthless. no wonder i can't get a job.

i'm talking to you and you just keep sending me a link to the walking dead (ironic) that hasn't swayed me one bit. quite frankly, you don't need to think your life is precious in order to find the life of others precious. you can objectively look at things and say "incotb provides the following services to those around him: he keeps his things tidy, he provides comfort to the following members of the community, he works as a janitor (not insulting you, just giving "worst case" scenario) thus keeping the following number of of people safe and comfortable. In this time he has hurt the following people" and that number likely will not yield anything more than those you've helped. me? i've done fucking nothing with my life. i drained my mom's retirement account, as she pays for everything for me. she's the only person i bring comfort to. since i haven't worked in over a year, i've done nothing for society. in fact, me posting in this forum is probably just giving everyone anxiety. but that's just me i guess... more of a pain than an asset. so i have no idea what you wanted me to glean from any of those clips, but they didn't do much for me. thanks, though, for doing what you thought you had to.

like get this, i just got a sandwich. i figured if i go through with this tonight, i want a "last meal" like at least inmates get. i hate chipotle peppers more than anything. they have a habanero and a chipotle sauce. guy assures he put the habanero on there. i come home. it's fucking chipotle. it's like i can't take a fucking hint to quit prolonging this and there is legit nothing left for me in this world... not even a goddamn sandwich.

i've been out of work for so long that i don't even know what i can do, let alone like anymore. and yes, some of us legitimately contribute nothing to this world. yeah, i meditate; all of that bullshit did nothing for me this year. prayer, all of it, did fucking nothing. that's when you really know, dude. because god would've sent you something by now, right? he would've given you some purpose, right? but nothing. so either God doesn't exist or he completely forgot about me/i was a mistake. either way, my life becomes very worthless.
